target_customer: Teams building and shipping AI agents that need pre-release testing
problem: Teams cannot cheaply and systematically benchmark AI agents before customers meet failures.

founders.name: Aaksha Meghawat
founders.background_notes: YC page: led the simulation and evaluation stack at Moveworks, shipped edge speech models at Apple, CMU transformer research, Interspeech 2021 best paper nomination. Degrees not listed.

founders.name: Tim Michaud
founders.background_notes: YC page says he used similar world-model technology at Moveworks and holds public CVEs for Apple products. Title not stated.

competitors.name: Coval
competitors.what: Evaluation and simulation for voice and chat AI agents

competitors.name: Cekura
competitors.what: Testing and monitoring for voice and chat AI agents

technical_complexity.rationale: World-model simulators that interview agents on CPU need research-grade engineering; founders cite similar work at Moveworks.

defensibility.rationale: Several funded rivals already offered agent simulation and founders are a two-person team; no data or integration lock-in shown.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition or copying found in searches as of 2026-11.

market_need_then: Agent launches surged in 2025 (Spring 2025 YC batch had about 70 agent startups per a trade report) and teams needed testing before production.

branding.name_origin: Not stated by any source found. The word is Japanese for clever, but no source ties the name to that.

identity.visual_style: Simple modern dashboard-style site with metric cards and report examples

brand_strength.rationale: Little coverage of the brand itself beyond the company site and directories.

outcome_analysis: Kashikoi is a two-person Spring 2025 company selling agent simulation to AI teams. No exit, shutdown or layoff was found as of 2026-11, so the outcome is still open. Its edge is founder experience building similar simulation at Moveworks, while the weak points are crowded rivals such as Coval and Cekura and thin public traction data.
notes: VCBacked (single aggregator) lists $500K pre-seed from YC in June 2025; unverified and likely YC's standard deal, so not recorded as a round. Outcome search found no news. Competition list is short because few dated sources exist.
